name: What is the process for starting a remodeling project with a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a remodeling project with a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation where you discuss your vision, needs, and budget. The contractor will then conduct an on-site assessment and provide a detailed proposal and estimate. Once an agreement is reached, design plans are finalized, permits are secured, and a schedule is established. Construction then commences, with regular communication and progress updates, culminating in project completion and final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Starting a remodel involves an initial consultation, on-site assessment, proposal, design finalization, permit acquisition, scheduling, construction, and a final walkthrough.
